Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 앞으로 의뢰를 가려서 받으라고 툴툴댄다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> blames me for accepting it, and complains that I should be more picky about what I accept.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN:
依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、
これからは依頼を見極めて受けるようにと文句を言っている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>抱怨着以后接委托要挑一下。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>抱怨著以後接委託要挑一下。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Ayant échoué à la commission, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> grommelle qu'il faut choisir les commissions plus attentivement la prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat den Auftrag nicht erfüllt und murrt, dass sie das nächste Mal Aufträge sorgfältiger auswählen sollte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El personaje <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> falló la misión y se quejó de que eligiera las misiones con más cuidado.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que falhou na comissão, reclamou de forma descontente, dizendo que deveriam escolher melhor as comissões da próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ผู้ที่ทำภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> บ่นว่าคราวหน้าให้เลือกภารกิจให้ดีกว่านี้หน่อย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Misi yang gagal dilakukan oleh <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> membuatnya menggerutu agar kali berikutnya lebih selektif dalam memilih misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thất bại trong nhiệm vụ và cằn nhằn về việc lần sau phải chọn nhiệm vụ cẩn thận hơn.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> कमीशन में विफल रही और अगली बार अधिक सावधानी से कमीशन चुनने के बारे में बड़बड़ाती है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Next time, I'll pick a better quest.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 次はいい依頼を受けてくるよ。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 下次我会挑个好一点的委托。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 下次我會挑個好一點的委託。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Prochainement, je choisirai une bonne mission.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nächstes Mal wähle ich eine gute Aufgabe aus.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Próximamente te daré un buen encargo.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Na próxima, escolherei um bom encargo.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kali depan, pilih tugas yang bagus.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 다행히 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 기분이 좀 풀린 것 같은 눈치다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Fortunately, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> seemed to be in a slightly better mood.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 幸い、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は少し機嫌がよくなったようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 幸好<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来似乎稍微气消了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 幸好<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來似乎稍微氣消了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Heureusement, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble un peu plus détendu(e).
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Zum Glück scheint <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> etwas besser gelaunt zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Afortunadamente, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece estar de mejor humor.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Felizmente <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece estar de melhor humor.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: โชคดีที่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนอารมณ์จะดีขึ้นเล็กน้อย
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: May mắn thay, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ đã vui vẻ hơn.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: सौभाग्य से, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का मूड थोड़ा बेहतर लग रहा है।

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: やはり<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は疲れ切っている様子だ…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ยังคง <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหนื่อยล้า...
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: अभी भी, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> थकी हुई लग रही है...

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 포션이 마음에 들었는지, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 표정이 한층 밝아졌다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Perhaps the potion helped. <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s expression noticeably brightened.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: ポーションが気に入ったのか、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の表情が一段と明るくなった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 或许是药水很合她的心意，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的表情变得更加明亮了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 或許是藥水很合她的心意，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的表情變得更加明亮了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Peut-être la potion lui a-t-elle plu, car l'expression de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est un peu éclaircie.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Vielleicht war der Trank nach ihrem Geschmack, denn <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Gesichtsausdruck hellte sich merklich auf.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Quizás la poción fue de su agrado, ya que la expresión de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se iluminó un poco.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Talvez a poção tenha sido do seu agrado, pois a expressão de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se iluminou um pouco.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: บางทีโพชั่นอาจจะถูกใจเธอ เพราะสีหน้าของ<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดูสดใสขึ้นเล็กน้อย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Mungkin ramuan itu sesuai seleranya, karena ekspresi <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sedikit cerah.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Có lẽ bình thuốc hợp ý cô ấy, vì vẻ mặt của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã tươi tỉnh hơn một chút.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: शायद औषधि उसे पसंद आई, क्योंकि <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के चेहरे पर थोड़ी चमक आ गई।
